controller.activation: SDL_INIT_GAMECONTROLLER is part of the SDL_Init flags at startup, and OpenOneGamepad() opens any recognized SDL_IsGameController() device, so the standard GameController path runs unconditionally on Linux.
controller.bindings: The game reads standardized SDL_GameControllerButton values (A/B/X/Y, shoulders, dpad) and SDL_GameControllerAxis (LEFTX/LEFTY for the movement d-pad emulation, TRIGGERLEFT/TRIGGERRIGHT for L2/R2). Knulli's SDL_GAMECONTROLLERCONFIG env var (preserved by launch.sh) supplies the RG CubeXX's own mapping string (b:b3,a:b4,leftshoulder:b7,rightshoulder:b8,lefttrigger:b13,righttrigger:b14,leftx:a0,lefty:a1,dpup:h0.1,...) so SDL2 translates the physical joystick indices/hat bits into those standardized enums before the game ever sees them; the trigger buttons (b13/b14) are still exposed through SDL_GameControllerGetAxis as a button-sourced axis (0 or 32767), which matches the >=12000 hysteresis check in HandleGamepadAxisInput.
controller.notes: BLOCKER (documented, not worked around): src/gen and variants/jp/gen -- the decompiled-to-C SNES program banks -- are absent from this source tree and cannot legitimately be produced offline, since they are generated from the copyrighted Mega Man X ROM via `tools/regen.sh --rom <player-owned dump>` (runner.cmake:850-905). We build the project's own documented 'SETUP HOST' mode (-DSNESRECOMP_SETUP_HOST=ON): the real runner/launcher/SDL2-GameController input stack ships, but src/setup_host.c makes SnesInit() abort instead of fabricating gameplay, and the only path forward is the in-app 'Generate & rebuild' wizard once the player supplies their own mmx.sfc. Controller handling above is identical in this mode (same host_main.c). Also disabled SNESRECOMP_NET_ICE (internet ICE/TURN netplay transport) because it FetchContents libjuice from github.com, unreachable in this offline container; LAN lobby/local multiplayer and all single-player/audio/rendering/translation code are untouched. Unresolved follow-up for a full playable image: pre-generate src/gen on a networked PC with the player's verified ROM via tools/regen.sh, then rebuild without SNESRECOMP_SETUP_HOST so the real game (not just the setup wizard) ships, and optionally vendor third_party/libjuice or set RNET_LIBJUICE_ROOT to restore internet netplay.
